name: Toradora!
description: Menacing in appearance but gentle at heart, second year high school student Ryuuji forms an unlikely friendship with classmate Taiga, a tiny girl with a sharp tongue and a tough attitude.

videos.title: The True Meaning of Bento
videos.overview: Kitamura brings a gigantic bento to school: His parents are on a business trip, so his grandma is taking care of him for the time being. While everyone else is happy to be allowed to eat from this bento, Takasu considers it a challenge to his own housewife skills; during the following days he tries to make creative special bentos in order to "beat" his mysterious opponent... before he learns what making bento is ultimately about.

videos.title: Tiger and Dragon
videos.overview: On the first day of school, Ryūji discovers that he and Taiga, the meanest girl in class, share a secret: each loves the other's best friend.

videos.title: Taiga and Ryuji
videos.overview: Taiga's efforts to get closer to Yūsaku fail: A scheme in basketball ends with Taiga knocked out, and she drops a plate of cookies out a window.

videos.title: Your Song
videos.overview: Ryūji and Taiga spend a day helping Minori at one of her many part-time jobs, and Ryūji gets to know her better when they're locked in a storehouse.

videos.title: That Look You Had
videos.overview: Taiga has a photo album full of blurry pictures of Kitamura. Ryūji offers to snap some pictures of him instead.

videos.title: Kawashima Ami
videos.overview: Yūsaku's childhood friend Ami, a model, transfers to the school and immediately becomes popular with everyone but Taiga, who sees the truth about her.

videos.title: True Self
videos.overview: Followed by a stalker, Ami hides out with Taiga and decides that she must discard her fake personality from now on.

videos.title: Pool's Open
videos.overview: When the school's pool opens for the summer, the gang shops for new swimsuits, and Ryūji helps Taiga with an embarrassing problem.

videos.title: Who Is This For?
videos.overview: Ryūji tries to help Taiga win a swimming race against Ami, but when Ryūji nearly drowns, the truth about Taiga's feelings comes out.

videos.title: When You Go To The Sea
videos.overview: During a trip to Ami's beach villa, Taiga has a nightmare about being married to Ryūji and schemes to bring him and Minori together.

videos.title: Fireworks
videos.overview: The gang plots an elaborate stunt to scare Minori with a trip to a nearby cave where Yūsaku has planted scary traps, but Yūsaku and Minori disappear.

videos.title: Ohashi High School Culture Festival 1
videos.overview: As preparations get under way for the school's cultural festival, Ryūji urges Taiga to consider reconciling with her estranged father.

videos.title: Ohashi High School Culture Festival 2
videos.overview: Taiga's reconciliation with her father divides her friends, but she ends up disappointed when her father doesn't attend her school play.

videos.title: Ohashi High School Culture Festival 3
videos.overview: Taiga wins a beauty contest despite a crushing disappointment about her father; a race is held to determine who will dance with Taiga.

videos.title: Palm-top Tiger of Happiness
videos.overview: A rumor starts that touching Taiga leads to good luck; Yūsaku gets some interesting news from the student council president.

videos.title: Distant Star
videos.overview: Yūsaku has a meltdown in class, dyes his hair blond and refuses to run for student council, causing everyone to wonder what's wrong with him.

videos.title: One Step Forward
videos.overview: Yūsaku reveals his love for Sumire, a student council president who is leaving to study abroad, so his friends urge him to run for her council seat.

videos.title: Mercury is Retrograde at Christmas
videos.overview: With Christmas approaching, the student council plans a party while Taiga decides to curry favor with Santa by playing Cupid for Ryūji and Minori.

videos.title: Underneath the Fir Tree
videos.overview: The entire class pitches in to assemble an artificial Christmas tree with a glass star, but a stray fly ball destroys the decorations.

videos.title: Christmas Eve Party
videos.overview: The love triangle of Ryūji, Minori and Taiga reaches a crisis point when true feelings are realized during the school's Christmas Eve party.

videos.title: Stay Like This Forever
videos.overview: The class trip to Okinawa is canceled, leading to a last-minute change of plans to a ski trip, where Ryūji resolves to tell Minori how he feels.

videos.title: Can't Help Myself
videos.overview: During the ski trip, Ryūji confesses his feelings for Minori, but not to her. When Taiga disappears, everyone frantically searches for her.

videos.title: When You're Around
videos.overview: Knowing that Taiga believes she was rescued by Yūsaku during the ski trip, Ryūji asks Yūsaku to pretend that she's correct.

videos.title: Path to Take
videos.overview: When Yasuko collapses from anemia due to overwork, Ryūji and Taiga take over her job of selling chocolate and use Ami's celebrity to improve sales.

videos.title: Confession
videos.overview: The truth about Taiga and Ryūji's feelings for each other finally comes out, and they make a plan to run off together and get married.

videos.title: Toradora!
videos.overview: When Yasuko reconciles with her parents, the truth about Ryūji's father is revealed, inspiring him to have a traditional wedding with Taiga.
